say:2:1310302001:1.text: Welcome, honored guests, to the Frozen Paw!
say:2:1310302001:1.source_cn: 尊敬的客人们，欢迎光临“白熊温泉旅馆”！

say:3:1310302002:1.text: Are you here to participate in the Ghostly Getaway activity?
say:3:1310302002:1.source_cn: 请问各位是来参加冬日祭典“鬼影密室”项目的吗？

say:4:1310302003:1.text: So that's the one everyone's talking about, the "most thrilling and popular" activity, right?
say:4:1310302003:1.source_cn: 原来“最有趣、最刺激、最受欢迎”的祭典项目叫鬼影密室呀！

choice_prompt:5:1310302003.text: So that's the one everyone's talking about, the "most thrilling and popular" activity, right?
choice_prompt:5:1310302003.source_cn: 原来“最有趣、最刺激、最受欢迎”的祭典项目叫鬼影密室呀！

say:6:1310302004:1.text: Think of it as a test of both your wit and courage. You'll have to escape from a pitch-black room, and trust me, the realism will have your heart racing!
say:6:1310302004:1.source_cn: 您可以将它理解为“利用智慧与勇气，从黑暗密室中逃脱”的...

say:7:1310302005:1.text: Please head inside and a staff member will explain all the details to you.
say:7:1310302005:1.source_cn: 请您前往旅店内，会有专门负责的员工为您介绍更详细的规则的。

say:8:1310302008:1.text: It sounds amazing... Chippy wants to try both the escape room and the hot springs...
say:8:1310302008:1.source_cn: 听起来好棒啊……满满既想参加鬼影密室项目，又想泡温泉……

say:9:1310302009:1.text: Can we take a look at the hot springs?

say:10:1310302010:0.text: Of course! You're welcome to explore the inn.
say:10:1310302010:0.source_cn: 当然可以！各位客人请随意在旅馆内游览。

say:11:1310302011:0.text: If you plan to soak in the hot springs, make sure to put on a towel! It's best not to wear your regular clothes there.
say:11:1310302011:0.source_cn: 客人们如果要泡温泉，还请先更换浴衣，最好不要穿着日常服...

say:13:1310302006:0.text: The Frozen Paw is the biggest and coziest hot springs inn around Cedartown. It's a bit on the pricier side, but absolutely worth it.
say:13:1310302006:0.source_cn: “白熊温泉旅馆”是雪松镇周围最大、最舒适的温泉旅馆，绝...

say:14:1310302007:1.text: We've got a great reputation here in Cedartown, and that's why we're handling such a major activity like the Ghostly Getaway!
say:14:1310302007:1.source_cn: 我们的旅馆在整个雪松镇有口皆碑。正因如此，我们才能承担...
